faq.q: What kinds of homes sit under $1.8M in South Surrey?
faq.a: Mostly townhomes, half duplexes, rowhomes and some detached houses, mainly in Grandview Heights, around Semiahmoo Town Centre and along King George Boulevard. Listings in this range include a Grandview townhouse and detached houses in Grandview and the King George Corridor.

faq.q: Which sub-areas carry the attached stock an under-$1.8M buyer is most likely to shop?
faq.a: On the published community figures, White Rock (193 active Condos & Townhomes listings), Grandview (146) and King George Corridor (131) held the largest attached inventories in September 2026, while Crescent Beach Ocean Park, Elgin Chantrell and Hazelmere were detached-led (SnapStats, September 2026)

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in South Surrey?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in South Surrey?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
